name: Halmos Labs
long_description:
AI can create new drugs and design experiments. They are limited by physical validation. 

physicalvalidation.com by Halmos Labs offers an API to execute any experiment. PhysicalValidation uses compounding knowledge and an experimental design AI to coordinate experiments through contracted labs faster and cheaper. 

Connecting physicalvalidation.com, Codex has designed and tested a new antibiotic without human intervention.
one_liner: One API to any physical experiment
